pages.title: What Is a Doll
pages.text:
A Doll is a loyal companion that wears your skin, follows you, and assists in combat, mining, woodcutting, farming, and fishing.

Each Doll has its own inventory and equipment slots.

Summon via a Doll Egg. Right-click ground with the egg to teleport the doll there. Right-click the doll with the egg to retrieve it. Each egg is permanently bound to its doll.

pages.title: Doll Variants
pages.text:
Two categories:

Normal: Tier 1 to 5. Higher tiers = more health and better regen. Max health: 100.

Special: Pale, Nether, Ender, Sea, Forest, Guide. Each has a unique aura and ability. Unified health: 120.

Warden Doll: strongest variant (200 HP). Must be obtained via shrine ritual. See "Endgame" category.

All variants can use all 8 work modes. Differences are stats and auras only.
